name: Regalia of the Pivot (Thiên Xu Tam Bảo)

bonuses.effect: Seal and Weight in One Hand (Ấn Quyền Đồng Thủ)
bonuses.rule: once each fight, a foe below half health who carries five Earth stacks is judged: stunned for 2 s, their strongest buff removed and their wards broken. While you hold all three, your own wards hold half their value: one who judges alone stands alone.

story: The founder's rule since 510: the one who seals does not weigh. The head holds the Seal and the Flag; the Chief Judge holds the Weight. The set has been whole twice: in Chung Hoài Cực's hands before he gave the Weight away, and for one day in 1188, when Doãn Ngọc Hành asked Phương Trực Ngôn for the Weight and judged Băng Tâm's petition himself (N-thien_xu-09). He returned it the next morning. She has not forgiven it.

name: The Armoured Horse (Thiết Mã Song Bảo)

bonuses.effect: The Army That Waits (Phục Binh Tại Cảnh)
bonuses.rule: with banner and tally both, you may open Thiết Mã Cảnh. In a fight, once, the riders join you as a companion for 10 s; their first hit makes the foe's soonest art wait 0.5 s. Outside a fight, the pair commands the army in the realm, which is a world event, not a stat.

story: Made in 785 for the war marshal (C154), parted at Chiết Kích in 803: the banner went into hiding with Lôi Vô Danh, the tally's halves into the realm and out of the archive. Đỗ Tinh Hà has looked for both for four hundred years. Ngũ Trấn Bắc wants them found; Doãn Ngọc Hành would prefer they were not.

name: Army-Breaker's Harness (Phá Quân Tam Kiện)

bonuses.rule: each full second in which you strike nothing lays one Earth stack on the foe you face; the Army-Breaker's waited thrust spends them all, and if it spends 5 or more it breaks the foe's ward entirely before it strikes.

story: Spear, coat and stone are what Đỗ Tinh Hà brought back from Phá Quân Môn in 874: the rebel's weapon, the rebel's armour, and the pebble he held while he waited at the gate. They have never been apart; the set dies with him or passes whole.

name: Bridge Court Pair (Kiều Đình Song Bảo)

bonuses.rule: a curse you lay on a foe who carries your Weight cannot be cleansed and lasts 2 s longer.

story: The court's own robe and jade, which go with the bench and not the person. She wears them beside the Weight, so the judge stands whole even when the Regalia is not.

name: Drum, Flag and Spear (Cổ Kỳ Thương)

bonuses.rule: each time the drum strikes, the foe with the least health is marked as the weak file for 6 s; your spear arts and every summon's strikes against it pierce a fifth of its resistances, and when it dies the drum strikes again at once.

story: The Dao Quang Hall's war kit, made piece by piece for its masters over four centuries. Ngũ Trấn Bắc holds all three, and wants the Armoured Horse to go with them.

name: Envoy's Credentials (Sứ Tiết Tam Bảo)

bonuses.effect: Words Before Needles (Tiên Ngôn Hậu Châm)
bonuses.rule: each attack you evade loads one needle into the fan, and each second in which you strike, one needle falls out. Your next fan art throws them all as extra needles; if you had struck no one before it, you may then leave the fight at once.

story: Tally, robe and fan are issued to the master of the Khai Dương Hall and handed back when he leaves the post. Mâu Tri Viễn has held them since 1150.

name: Keeper's Desk (Tàng Ước Tam Bảo)

bonuses.effect: The Door Stays Shut (Môn Bất Khai)
bonuses.rule: while you are Composed, each seal art you cast lays a seal-ward on you worth 4 % of your linh lực, and each seal-ward loses a tenth of its value each second; a foe whose name the inkstone has written three times holds its arts: those that come ready in the next 2 s wait until the 2 s end.

story: The founder's key, the Compact's inkstone and the keeper's own robe. The key and stone pass with the archive; the robe is hers, and the Pivot will have to make another.

name: Plumb and Level (Chuẩn Thằng Quy Củ)

bonuses.rule: your sword arts cannot miss a foe carrying your Metal stacks, and every fifth sword hit in a row sends one of the Hundred Swords down the same line at no cost.

story: His master's tools of the seat: the sword that sets a line, the level that sets a floor, and the plate the steward wears. Given one at a time as he earned them; the elders read the third as a promise.

name: Dawn Pair (Hi Hòa Song Bảo)

bonuses.rule: your first sword art each fight is a certain crit; if its hit does not make the foe Broken, your next ward is doubled. (Her master's lesson, half learned.)

story: Doãn Ngọc Hành had Chân Kim Các refine the sword for her Trúc Cơ in 1168 and gave her the flag twelve years later, so that she would carry the ward as well as the edge.

name: Copyist's Pair (Sao Lục Song Bảo)

bonuses.rule: once a fight, the first soul or curse art cast on you is copied instead of taken; your next seal art carries it back to its caster.

story: The archive's issue to its copyists, returned when they leave the second door. The ink of a copy no one should have made is still in the left sleeve of Thích Minh Thư's.
